name: Elixir-3DBioInfo-Benchmark-Protein-Interfaces
description: Elixir-3DBioInfo-Benchmark-Protein-Interfaces evaluates methods that predict protein–protein interaction interfaces from 3D structural data. It measures a model's ability to identify interface residues, discriminate interacting vs non-interacting surfaces, and quantify interface properties using benchmark protein complexes. The tasks focus on per-residue classification and related scoring tasks relevant to structural bioinformatics.
reputation: Specialized benchmark in the 3D bioinformatics community with moderate recognition among structural biology researchers.
